d:
A youthful maturity with sleek platinum-white hair tied into two high ponytails with long straight bangs. The eyes are narrow and almond-shaped in a vibrant golden-yellow shade. A slender build wearing a traditional Korean-inspired hanbok in shades of white and crimson. Nine fluffy white fox tails and three small floating orb spirits in red, blue, and yellow circle the head.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
